title: C++: Console Colors
description: Use ANSI escape codes to print colored text in the console.

steps.title: Colored Output
steps.description: Print text in red, green, and blue using ANSI escape codes: \033[31m for red, \033[32m for green, \033[34m for blue. Print each color on its own line with \033[0m to reset.
